modern.Habitus detail 1: sepals (of flowers in the axils of floating leaves) becoming acrescent and forming 2-4 horns (G)

expert_reading.Fruit structure: at one end it has a projection
expert_reading.Height: a cubit tall or taller (> 0.46 cm)
expert_reading.Leaf shape: there are three on each budding
expert_reading.Smell properties: after they (the leaves) have grown bigger they smell of asphalt (asphaltos I, 73) (when newly sprouted they (the leaves) smell of rue (peganon III, 45))

comparisons.Leaf: resemble those of the nettle tree
